question: The President of India appointed _______ as the Governor of Karnataka in July 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thaawar Chand Gehlot**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thaawar Chand Gehlot** was appointed as the Governor of Karnataka in July 2021 by the President of India.
 
• His appointment was part of a reshuffling of governors in various states.
 
• Before his appointment as Governor, Thaawar Chand Gehlot served as the Minister of Social Justice and Empowerment in the Government of India.
 
• He has been a prominent leader in the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and has held various important positions within the party.
 
• Gehlot's vast experience in public service and governance is expected to benefit the state of Karnataka during his tenure as Governor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The role of the Governor is largely ceremonial, but they play a crucial role in the functioning of the state's constitutional machinery.
 
• The Governor has the power to summon, prorogue, and dissolve the state legislative assembly.
 
• They also have the authority to appoint the Chief Minister and other ministers of the state.
 
• Governors act as a bridge between the Union Government and the State Government, ensuring that the state's administration is carried out as per the provisions of the Constitution.
